name: Peek Pay
summary: A Pay button that runs a face check inside itself, then smiles, ticks and pays
about: A checkout card with a Pay button that holds a small face scanner. Pressing it squashes the button and the face glances around, then a progress ring fills, cyan brackets hunt and a scan line sweeps while the label counts to 100%. A match snaps the brackets in, the face smiles and turns into a tick with a ripple, sparks and a PAID stamp; a no-match shakes it red.
how: Press Pay: the button squashes and the face glances around
A ring fills around the face, a scan line sweeps and the label counts up
On a match the brackets snap in and the face smiles
The face becomes a tick, the button ripples green and sparks fly
A PAID stamp and a receipt line appear, then the button resets
Turn on Simulate no match to see the red shake and the Try again state
